question: A $50$ cm long steel rod is clamped rigidly at both ends at $20°$C and then heated to $70°$C. Find the thermal stress produced, in units of $10^8$ Pa. ($Y = 2 \times 10^{11}$ Pa, $\alpha = 1.2 \times 10^{-5}\ °\text{C}^{-1}$)
solution:
$$\sigma = Y\alpha\Delta T = 2 \times 10^{11} \times 1.2 \times 10^{-5} \times 50 = 1.2 \times 10^8\ \text{Pa}$$

(The length does not matter.)
